  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "social",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish mid-invocation, twisting the sacrifice toward Lirael’s unspoken wound in front of the whole assembly",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_actor_id": "named:seren",
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-wish, her fingers tightening around the ceremonial sash she’s supposed to be holding steady",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s muffled cry behind the mouthband goes unheard as the presiding Dohkar’s gaze sharpens on Seren’s hesitation",
      "Julian steps forward, his bare feet silent on the spiralgrass, watching the Dohkar’s reaction like a man calculating odds"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Let Seren name the wound aloud and risk the rite’s collapse, or tear the mouthband off and shout her own warning?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_element_ids": ["O1", "O4", "O5"],
    "environment_realizations": {
      "O1": "the weeping-willow veil-canopy trembles as if stirred by an unseen wind, though the air is still",
      "O4": "the gossamer mouthband clings to Lirael’s lips like a second skin, damp with her breath",
      "O5": "the ornamented sash at her waist glints with a single, unmistakable thread of silver—Seren’s signature"
    },
    "interlocutor_placement": "the presiding Dohkar — the senior Dohkar who has overseen Seren’s training, his silver-streaked braid coiled tight at the nape of his neck, the way he always does when he’s about to correct someone",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "beat 1 — Lirael adjusts the mouthband with her teeth, the silver thread of Seren’s sash catching on her fingers, and thinks: *This is how it starts. The unraveling.*",
    "scene_want": "wants to stop Seren from naming the wound without breaking the rite’s sacred silence",
    "scene_mission": "halt the twisted wish before the presiding Dohkar calls for the cost to be spoken aloud",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is mid-sacrifice, the Dohkar is watching closely, and Lirael’s mouth is bound",
      "believes": "the rite is about to collapse unless someone acts",
      "wondering": "what Julian’s presence here means",
      "must_not_confuse": "who is physically present, who is speaking, and why the mouthband matters"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — signature_feature (the crooked front tooth)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way Julian’s gaze lingers on the Dohkar’s hands, counting the seconds before he moves)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_OPENING_BEAT" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s fingers brush the silver thread in Lirael’s sash as she stumbles over the words, her voice softening the wound’s name into something unrecognizable",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E4",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "The silver thread is Seren’s signature—she’s naming the wound but softening it, avoiding direct recognition.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "PERSONALIZE_SOCIAL_HARM",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes blurring the wound is kinder than making it clear"
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTROL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s fingers tap once against his ceremonial sash—his signal to halt the rite—before he speaks the cost aloud",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E6",
        "behavior_object_ids": [],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "He assumes his judgment carries authority over Seren’s misstep, enforcing the rite’s order despite her hesitation.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar believes his role gives him the right to override Seren’s choice"
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target_object_id": "O5",
      "axis": "ownership",
      "beat": "the silver thread in Lirael’s sash glints, unmistakable—Seren’s mark, woven into the fabric without permission"
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "She is the only one who notices the silver thread in her sash—Seren’s signature, a violation of the rite’s rules",
      "beat": "Lirael’s fingers twitch toward the silver thread in her sash, but she freezes—touching it would break the silence, and the Dohkar is already watching"
    }
